exercises.name: Push Ups
exercises.description: A classic upper body exercise that works your chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Keep your core tight and back straight throughout.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: The fundamental lower body exercise for building leg strength and power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips back and down as if sitting in a chair.
Keep your chest up and knees behind your toes.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and hold the position.
Don't let your hips sag or rise.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at sides.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms above head.
Jump again to return to starting position.
Repeat in a fluid motion.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Great for balance and leg strength.
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower your hips.
Both knees should be bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keep your front knee above your ankle.
Push back to starting position and switch legs.

exercises.name: Burpees
instructions: From standing, drop into a squat and place hands on floor.
Kick feet back into a plank.
Perform a push-up.
Jump feet back to hands and jump up into the air.
